fields.name: SqlParameterMapAttribute SQL parameter mapping contract
fields.contract: SqlParameterMapAttribute defines the abstract SQL-specific attribute contract for mapping a model property to a database parameter or column. A concrete mapping attribute is initialized with the target name and SQL database type, and may additionally declare that a database-null value makes the containing model unavailable. Each concrete mapping attribute must supply the table-valued-parameter mapping operation for its property, contributing its property mapping, SQL metadata, and ordinal position to the caller-supplied mapping collections.
